caption: The drawing depicts a single, large stoneware jug with a rounded body and a short, cylindrical neck that features a handle attached from the neck to the upper shoulder. The jug is primarily beige or light tan in color, with subtle shading to indicate three-dimensionality and some darker spots for texture. Near the top, on the shoulder of the jug, there is a blue decorative motif consisting of stylized leaves and possibly a flower, rendered in a painterly fashion. Above the design, there is a line of blue text written in an arc that appears to read “W. Mohpett & Son / Canaan, N.Y.”, followed by a decorative swirl or flourish. The background is plain and off-white. The overall composition centers the jug on the paper, with the jug dominating most of the space.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
